review_type: independent assistant code review of parent-authored conversation/composition and sibling-authored evidence/validation changes; no answer scoring

validation.command: PYTHONPATH=src:tests .venv/bin/python -m unittest test_routing_lifecycle_revalidation test_lifecycle_history_repair test_memory_lifecycle_validation test_routing test_memory_intent_regressions test_lightweight_routing test_pair_remediation -v
validation.additional_assertions_description: Temporal-only locations rejected (5 x evidence/composition); named venues retained (3 x evidence/composition); correction-metadata false positives rejected (4); genuine correction-time requests retained (3); dated/current or conditional location shortcuts rejected (4); conflicting canonical/event metadata composition rejected (1).

findings.finding: Location composition removed a dated historical qualifier for a current-location question.
findings.resolution: Question and source tense must agree; a date is omitted only when the question explicitly supplies the event date.

findings.finding: The new location early return bypassed canonical/event_time date consistency checks.
findings.resolution: Location composition now follows the existing canonical and metadata date coherence check.

findings.finding: Conditional locations entered the verified-location shortcut despite the bounded composition contract.
findings.resolution: Conditional suffixes including unless and except now decline extractive composition.

findings.finding: Temporal-only on Monday, at noon, in June and ISO-date values could be treated as locations.
findings.resolution: The shared evidence slot rejects wholly temporal values while preserving named venues such as Monday Hall, June Room and Room 12.

findings.finding: Event-time questions mentioning a prior change could request correction metadata even without asking when the change occurred.
findings.resolution: Correction-time detection now requires a question predicate targeting change, an explicit time-of-correction request, or an explicit chronology about when the change happened. Four adversarial event-time counterexamples now remain false.

findings.finding: Self-review of the new routing followup heuristic found generic assistant phrases containing your or you have could trigger personal routing.
findings.resolution: The heuristic now requires an initial personal fact assertion and excludes generic question/example/code subjects. Three general-topic counterexamples pass.

positive_checks: All personal-memory generation omits retained factual history while retaining the session for routing.
Memory retrieval snapshots remain checked before generation and before delivery.
Generation prompts no longer contain concrete fictional preference/person/time examples.
Real raw router outputs remain recorded independently of deterministic memory-policy overrides.
limits: Routing still uses bounded English heuristics and model classification for unsupported paraphrases; this is not universal non-disclosure assurance.
Prior conversation lacks per-record provenance; unresolved pronoun-only recall may abstain after safe revalidation.
The metadata consistency check declines the extractive shortcut; this code review does not claim all possible contradictory source data is automatically corrected.
Offline fake transports test control flow and validation, not live generation quality.
The reviewer implemented routing changes and therefore does not provide independent authorship separation for that file.
